translations.en.sahih: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
translations.en.pickthall: By the emissary winds, (sent) one after another
translations.en.yusufali: By the (Winds) sent forth one after another (to man's profit);
translations.id.indonesian: Demi malaikat-malaikat yang diutus untuk membawa kebaikan,

translations.en.sahih: And the winds that blow violently
translations.en.pickthall: By the raging hurricanes,
translations.en.yusufali: Which then blow violently in tempestuous Gusts,
translations.id.indonesian: dan (malaikat-malaikat) yang terbang dengan kencangnya,

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]
translations.en.pickthall: By those which cause earth's vegetation to revive;
translations.en.yusufali: And scatter (things) far and wide;
translations.id.indonesian: dan (malaikat-malaikat) yang menyebarkan (rahmat Tuhannya) dengan seluas-luasnya,

translations.en.sahih: And those [angels] who bring criterion
translations.en.pickthall: By those who winnow with a winnowing,
translations.en.yusufali: Then separate them, one from another,
translations.id.indonesian: dan (malaikat-malaikat) yang membedakan (antara yang hak dan yang bathil) dengan sejelas-jelasnya,

translations.en.sahih: And those [angels] who deliver a message
translations.en.pickthall: By those who bring down the Reminder,
translations.en.yusufali: Then spread abroad a Message,
translations.id.indonesian: dan (malaikat-malaikat) yang menyampaikan wahyu,

translations.en.sahih: As justification or warning,
translations.en.pickthall: To excuse or to warn,
translations.en.yusufali: Whether of Justification or of Warning;-
translations.id.indonesian: untuk menolak alasan-alasan atau memberi peringatan,

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.
translations.en.pickthall: Surely that which ye are promised will befall.
translations.en.yusufali: Assuredly, what ye are promised must come to pass.
translations.id.indonesian: sesungguhnya apa yang dijanjikan kepadamu itu pasti terjadi.

translations.en.sahih: So when the stars are obliterated
translations.en.pickthall: So when the stars are put out,
translations.en.yusufali: Then when the stars become dim;
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apabila bintang-bintang telah dihapuskan,

translations.en.sahih: And when the heaven is opened
translations.en.pickthall: And when the sky is riven asunder,
translations.en.yusufali: When the heaven is cleft asunder;
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila langit telah dibelah,

translations.en.sahih: And when the mountains are blown away
translations.en.pickthall: And when the mountains are blown away,
translations.en.yusufali: When the mountains are scattered (to the winds) as dust;
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila gunung-gunung telah dihancurkan menjadi debu,

translations.en.sahih: And when the messengers' time has come...
translations.en.pickthall: And when the messengers are brought unto their time appointed -
translations.en.yusufali: And when the messengers are (all) appointed a time (to collect);-
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila rasul-rasul telah ditetapkan waktu (mereka).

translations.en.sahih: For what Day was it postponed?
translations.en.pickthall: For what day is the time appointed?
translations.en.yusufali: For what Day are these (portents) deferred?
translations.id.indonesian: (Niscaya dikatakan kepada mereka:) "Sampai hari apakah ditangguhkan (mengazab orang-orang kafir itu)?"

translations.en.sahih: For the Day of Judgement.
translations.en.pickthall: For the Day of Decision.
translations.en.yusufali: For the Day of Sorting out.
translations.id.indonesian: Sampai hari keputusan.

transliteration: Wa maaa adraaka maa yawmul fasl

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
translations.en.pickthall: And what will convey unto thee what the Day of Decision is! -
translations.en.yusufali: And what will explain to thee what is the Day of Sorting out?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tahukah kamu apakah hari keputusan itu?

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
translations.en.yusufali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
translations.id.indonesian: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

translations.en.sahih: Did We not destroy the former peoples?
translations.en.pickthall: Destroyed We not the former folk,
translations.en.yusufali: Did We not destroy the men of old (for their evil)?
translations.id.indonesian: Bukankah Kami telah membinasakan orang-orang yang dahulu?

translations.en.sahih: Then We will follow them with the later ones.
translations.en.pickthall: Then caused the latter folk to follow after?
translations.en.yusufali: So shall We make later (generations) follow them.
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu Kami iringkan (azab Kami terhadap) mereka dengan (mengazab) orang-orang yang datang kemudian.

translations.en.sahih: Thus do We deal with the criminals.
translations.en.pickthall: Thus deal We ever with the guilty.
translations.en.yusufali: Thus do We deal with men of sin.
translations.id.indonesian: Demikianlah Kami berbuat terhadap orang-orang yang berdosa.

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
translations.en.yusufali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
translations.id.indonesian: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

translations.en.sahih: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
translations.en.pickthall: Did We not create you from a base fluid
translations.en.yusufali: Have We not created you from a fluid (held) despicable?-
translations.id.indonesian: Bukankah Kami menciptakan kamu dari air yang hina?

translations.en.sahih: And We placed it in a firm lodging
translations.en.pickthall: Which We laid up in a safe abode
translations.en.yusufali: The which We placed in a place of rest, firmly fixed,
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian Kami letakkan dia dalam tempat yang kokoh (rahim),

translations.en.sahih: For a known extent.
translations.en.pickthall: For a known term?
translations.en.yusufali: For a period (of gestation), determined (according to need)?
translations.id.indonesian: sampai waktu yang ditentukan,

translations.en.sahih: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
translations.en.pickthall: Thus We arranged. How excellent is Our arranging!
translations.en.yusufali: For We do determine (according to need); for We are the best to determine (things).
translations.id.indonesian: lalu Kami tentukan (bentuknya), maka Kami-lah sebaik-baik yang menentukan.

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
translations.en.yusufali: Ah woe, that Day! to the Rejecters of Truth!
translations.id.indonesian: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

translations.en.sahih: Have We not made the earth a container
translations.en.pickthall: Have We not made the earth a receptacle
translations.en.yusufali: Have We not made the earth (as a place) to draw together.
translations.id.indonesian: Bukankah Kami menjadikan bumi (tempat) berkumpul,

translations.en.sahih: Of the living and the dead?
translations.en.pickthall: Both for the living and the dead,
translations.en.yusufali: The living and the dead,
translations.id.indonesian: orang-orang hidup dan orang-orang mati?

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَـٰمِخَـٰتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُم مَّآءً فُرَاتًا
transliteration: Wa ja'alnaa feehaa rawaasiya shaamikhaatinw wa asqainaakum maaa'an furaataa

translations.en.sahih: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
translations.en.pickthall: And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein?
translations.en.yusufali: And made therein mountains standing firm, lofty (in stature); and provided for you water sweet (and wholesome)?
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami jadikan padanya gunung-gunung yang tinggi, dan Kami beri minum kamu dengan air tawar?

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
translations.en.yusufali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
translations.id.indonesian: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
transliteration: Intaliqooo ilaa maa kuntum bihee tukazziboon

translations.en.sahih: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.
translations.en.pickthall: (It will be said unto them:) Depart unto that (doom) which ye used to deny;
translations.en.yusufali: (It will be said:) "Depart ye to that which ye used to reject as false!
translations.id.indonesian: (Dikatakan kepada mereka pada hari kiamat): "Pergilah kamu mendapatkan azab yang dahulunya kamu mendustakannya.

arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِى ثَلَـٰثِ شُعَبٍ
transliteration: Intaliqooo ilaa zillin zee salaasi shu'ab

translations.en.sahih: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns
translations.en.pickthall: Depart unto the shadow falling threefold,
translations.en.yusufali: "Depart ye to a Shadow (of smoke ascending) in three columns,
translations.id.indonesian: Pergilah kamu mendapatkan naungan yang mempunyai tiga cabang,

arabic: لَّا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
transliteration: Laa zaleelinw wa laa yughnee minal lahab

translations.en.sahih: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."
translations.en.pickthall: (Which yet is) no relief nor shelter from the flame.
translations.en.yusufali: "(Which yields) no shade of coolness, and is of no use against the fierce Blaze.
translations.id.indonesian: yang tidak melindungi dan tidak pula menolak nyala api neraka".

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! it throweth up sparks like the castles,
translations.en.yusufali: "Indeed it throws about sparks (huge) as Forts,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya neraka itu melontarkan bunga api sebesar dan setinggi istana.

translations.en.sahih: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.
translations.en.pickthall: (Or) as it might be camels of bright yellow hue.
translations.en.yusufali: "As if there were (a string of) yellow camels (marching swiftly)."
translations.id.indonesian: Seolah-olah ia iringan unta yang kuning.

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
translations.en.yusufali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
translations.id.indonesian: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

translations.en.sahih: This is a Day they will not speak,
translations.en.pickthall: This is a day wherein they speak not,
translations.en.yusufali: That will be a Day when they shall not be able to speak.
translations.id.indonesian: Ini adalah hari, yang mereka tidak dapat berbicara (pada hari itu),

transliteration: Wa laa yu'zanu lahum fa ya'taziroon

translations.en.sahih: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.
translations.en.pickthall: Nor are they suffered to put forth excuses.
translations.en.yusufali: Nor will it be open to them to put forth pleas.
translations.id.indonesian: dan tidak diizinkan kepada mereka minta uzur sehingga mereka (dapat) minta uzur.

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
translations.en.yusufali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
translations.id.indonesian: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

transliteration: Haaza yawmul fasli jama 'naakum wal awwaleen

translations.en.sahih: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
translations.en.pickthall: This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old together.
translations.en.yusufali: That will be a Day of Sorting out! We shall gather you together and those before (you)!
translations.id.indonesian: Ini adalah hari keputusan; (pada hari ini) Kami mengumpulkan kamu dan orang-orang terdahulu.

transliteration: Fa in kaana lakum kaidun fakeedoon

translations.en.sahih: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
translations.en.pickthall: If now ye have any wit, outwit Me.
translations.en.yusufali: Now, if ye have a trick (or plot), use it against Me!
translations.id.indonesian: Jika kamu mempunyai tipu daya, maka lakukanlah tipu dayamu itu terhadap-Ku.

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
translations.en.yusufali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
translations.id.indonesian: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! those who kept their duty are amid shade and fountains,
translations.en.yusufali: As to the Righteous, they shall be amidst (cool) shades and springs (of water).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang bertakwa berada dalam naungan (yang teduh) dan (di sekitar) mata-mata air.

translations.en.sahih: And fruits from whatever they desire,
translations.en.pickthall: And fruits such as they desire.
translations.en.yusufali: And (they shall have) fruits,- all they desire.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan (mendapat) buah-buahan dari (macam-macam) yang mereka ingini.

arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
transliteration: Kuloo washraboo haneee 'am bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

translations.en.sahih: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
translations.en.pickthall: (Unto them it is said:) Eat, drink and welcome, O ye blessed, in return for what ye did.
translations.en.yusufali: "Eat ye and drink ye to your heart's content: for that ye worked (Righteousness).
translations.id.indonesian: (Dikatakan kepada mereka): "Makan dan minumlah kamu dengan enak karena apa yang telah kamu kerjakan".

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
translations.en.pickthall: Thus do We reward the good.
translations.en.yusufali: Thus do We certainly reward the Doers of Good.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya demikianlah Kami memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang berbuat baik.

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
translations.en.yusufali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
translations.id.indonesian: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

transliteration: Kuloo wa tamatta'oo qaleelan innakum mujrimoon

translations.en.sahih: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
translations.en.pickthall: Eat and take your ease (on earth) a little. Lo! ye are guilty.
translations.en.yusufali: (O ye unjust!) Eat ye and enjoy yourselves (but) a little while, for that ye are Sinners.
translations.id.indonesian: (Dikatakan kepada orang-orang kafir): "Makanlah dan bersenang-senanglah kamu (di dunia dalam waktu) yang pendek; sesungguhnya kamu adalah orang-orang yang berdosa".

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
translations.en.yusufali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
translations.id.indonesian: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
transliteration: Wa izaa qeela lahumur ka'oo aa yarka'oon

translations.en.sahih: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.
translations.en.pickthall: When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down!
translations.en.yusufali: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate yourselves!" they do not so.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apabila dikatakan kepada mereka: "Rukuklah, niscaya mereka tidak mau ruku'.

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
translations.en.yusufali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
translations.id.indonesian: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

translations.en.sahih: Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe?
translations.en.pickthall: In what statement, after this, will they believe?
translations.en.yusufali: Then what Message, after that, will they believe in?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka kepada perkataan apakah selain Al Quran ini mereka akan beriman?
